name: Naratriptan 2.5mg — 6 Tablets (Generic for Amerge®)
short: Naratriptan 2.5mg — 6 Tablets (Generic for Amerge®) — Prescription required. Trusted bilingual delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, 24/7.
description:
Naratriptan 2.5mg — 6 Tablets (Generic for Amerge®) belongs to the triptan class of medications used in the acute management of migraine episodes under physician direction. Each unit is sealed in original blister packaging and stored under recommended conditions at our Cabo facility.

Typical use is at the onset of a migraine attack, with dose and frequency individualized by your healthcare provider. Not intended for migraine prevention. Consult your physician if symptoms persist or if you experience cardiovascular risk factors.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Discreet delivery to your hotel within Cabo San Lucas or San José del Cabo.
